annotations.title: Sign in to a Government of Canada online account - Canada.ca

content.text:
To log in to **My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**, use the official Canada.ca page:

**Go to:** Canada.ca → **My Service Canada Account (MSCA)** ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/myservicecanadaaccount?utm_source=openai))

You can sign in using one of these options:

- **Interac Sign-In Partner** — your online banking login
- **GCKey** — Government of Canada username and password
- **Provincial sign-in** — currently for **BC and Alberta** users ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/myservicecanadaaccount?utm_source=openai))

**Tip:** Use the same sign-in method you used when you created the account; it’s tied to your MSCA profile. ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/myservicecanadaaccount?utm_source=openai))

If you’re trying to access CRA tax info, use **CRA My Account** instead; MSCA is mainly for things like EI, CPP, OAS, Records of Employment, direct deposit for benefits, and related Service Canada services. ([canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/sign-in-online-account.html?lang=en&utm_source=openai))
